scope.summary: Four audit-crate hardenings, each with a real versioned migration so existing chains keep verifying byte-for-byte: (AU1) schema v11 domain-separates the entry-hash preimage with an explicit application-domain label while v1-v10 records still verify under their original label-free computation; (AU2) U+2028/U+2029 are escaped in both serialization sinks; (AU3) the Rekor head binding is parsed structurally/exactly; (AU4) secrets are scrubbed from audit error messages.

entry_points.name: audit hash-chain preimage + serialization + Rekor + error scrubbing
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp-audit/{record,rekor,shipping,sink,verify}.rs: schema v11 domain-separated preimage with backward-compatible v1-v10 verification, U+2028/2029 escaping in both sinks, structural Rekor head parse, and secret scrubbing in errors — all landed in 89536b02 (the single source and last-touch for these files). Migration proven by old chains still verifying. cargo test -p oraclemcp-audit.

limitations: Scoped regression proof only; full gate green in CI at HEAD 5031d67e. All five scope files' last-touch is source 89536b02; the migration keeps pre-v11 chains verifying byte-for-byte.
